title: Yum Pets: Match & Feed
game_overview: Dynamic match-3 pet sanctuary puzzle game with infinite cycling biomes, pet-linked board treats, and algorithmic obstacle scaling.
winning_condition: Reach target happiness before moves run out to earn stars and advance.
losing_condition: Run out of moves without streak-saving; losing all stars demotes 1 level.

controls.action: Swap two adjacent treat tiles on the 5x5 puzzle grid to create matches of 3 or more.
Directly interact with the chubby bunny or pet it for bonus tactile feedback.

sections.title: Design Pillars
sections.content: 1. Tactile Slapstick Comedy: Pet reactions to different treats are exaggerated, playful, and bouncily animated. 2. Dual-Zone Dynamic Feedback: Every puzzle match immediately generates tangible physical items dropping into the top world. 3. Cozy Approachability: Gentle vibrant colors, rounded shapes, and clear visual cues invite quick casual sessions.
sections.summary: Core principles driving charm and engaging match-3 gameplay.

sections.title: Core Loop
sections.content: The player surveys the bottom 5x5 puzzle grid and swaps adjacent treat tiles (Berries, Hot Peppers, Ice Cubes, Balloons). Matching 3+ identical tiles spawns the corresponding treat item in the upper habitat island with 2D physics. The chubby bunny detects the treat, runs over, consumes it, and triggers a slapstick effect (Berry = Happy Dance, Pepper = Fiery Zoom Rush with smoke, Ice = Funny Frozen Ice Sculpture, Balloon = Floating Flight). Happiness points accumulate toward the 1,500 target while remaining moves tick down.
sections.summary: Primary cycle connecting the puzzle grid with habitat interactions.

sections.title: Core Mechanics
sections.content: 1. 5x5 Match-3 Engine: Standard orthogonal swaps with gravity cascades and refills. 4-in-a-row or 5-in-a-row matches produce super-treats that grant bonus score. 2. Island Physics Habitat: The top viewport features rigid ground, boundaries, bouncing treat drops, and animated particle effects. 3. Four Elemental Reactions: Berries trigger a cheerful hop-and-wiggle dance; Hot Peppers tint the bunny crimson and send it rocketing around the habitat leaving smoke trails; Ice Cubes turn into ice cream that freezes the bunny into an ice block for 3 seconds; Balloons attach to the bunny's paws lifting it gently to the sky before descending with parachute physics.
sections.summary: Detailed mechanics for puzzle matching and pet behavior states.

sections.title: Movement & Scrolling Alignment
sections.content: Scrolling Axis: Static single-screen vertical split (Top 50% Island Habitat, Bottom 50% 5x5 Match-3 Grid). Asset Orientation: Habitat entities face sideways towards horizontal movement trajectories with flip-rigid scaling. Movement Physics: Slapstick spring-damper bouncy acceleration, high restitution, and ground friction. Camera Behavior: Locked static dual-viewport camera framing both zones with clear demarcation.
sections.summary: Fixed split-screen viewport with lateral physics movement.

sections.title: Visual Hierarchy & Layering
sections.content: Layer Separation: Upper habitat features soft pastel sky and floating grassy meadow. Bottom puzzle board uses high-contrast warm wooden/candy borders and vibrant, easily distinguishable treat icons. Obstacle/Treat Affordance: Each of the four treat types has a distinct primary hue and silhouette (Ruby Red Berry, Fiery Crimson Pepper, Cyan Glacial Ice Cube, Golden Yellow/Pink Balloon). HUD Overlay: Happiness meter, move counter, and combo popups sit cleanly along the middle division and screen top.
sections.summary: Clear distinction between habitat simulation and puzzle board.

sections.title: Characters & Enemies
sections.content: Chubby Bunny ('Pip'): A spherical, ultra-squishy cartoon bunny with floppy ears, expressive cartoon eyes, and dynamic visual states (Standard, Cheerful, Spicy Turbo, Frozen Sculpture, Floating).

sections.title: Fairness Tools
sections.content: Automatic hint shaking if no move is made for 5 seconds; guaranteed reshuffle if no valid matches remain on the 5x5 board; clear move counter indicator.

sections.title: Juice & Game Feel
sections.content: Anticipation Juice: Treat tiles squash and stretch on drag and hover. State Change Juice: Comic smoke puffs for pepper speed boost, frosty mist for frozen pet, confetti on 4+ combos. Impact Juice: Screen bounce on treat island landing, celebratory sound effects, and floating floating point numbers.
sections.summary: Satisfying feedback across both screen zones.

sections.title: Social Mechanics & Audience
sections.content: Designed for casual puzzle players, pet simulator enthusiasts, and all-age audiences who appreciate cute aesthetic comedy.

sections.title: Accessibility
sections.content: High-contrast treat icons with unique shape silhouettes for colorblind accessibility, intuitive one-touch/swipe controls, and adjustable audio volume.

sections.title: Structural Integrity
sections.content: Title Splash Screen -> Main Game View (Split Habitat / Match-3) -> Victory Modal (with confetti & star rating) / Out of Moves Modal (with quick retry).

sections.title: Virtual Touch Controls Implementation
sections.content: The match-3 grid utilizes direct touch drag and tap detection with onPointerDown, onPointerMove, and onPointerUp listeners with touch-none CSS styling. Absolute buttons for pause and restart apply pointer-events-auto strictly on button elements.
sections.summary: Responsive touch handling on mobile viewports.
